summary: Comprehensive automated test pass for the NEW Boat (progetto) grouping feature. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_boats_api.py (16 tests, 16 PASS) covering the full boat/piece lifecycle. Boats CRUD: POST /api/boats returns id+piece_count(0)+thumb_url(null); GET /api/boats lists boat with piece_count & thumb_url fields; GET /api/boats/{id} returns boat with pieces:[]; PATCH renames boat (verified via GET); invalid ObjectId -> 400, missing -> 404. Pieces under boat: POST /api/projects with boat_id+piece_name creates the piece with correct boat_id, GET /api/projects?boat_id=... filters to that boat's pieces (2/2 returned), boat GET.pieces reflects them, boats list piece_count becomes 2. Contour + assembly: PATCH /api/projects/{id} with contour_mm rectangle persists (verified via GET); before contour_mm is set /api/boats/{id}/assembly returns 422 ('Nessun pezzo pronto'); after contours are set, GET /api/boats/{id}/assembly returns 200 with sheet_url (/api/files/... .pdf), count=2, overflow bool, total_area_m2>0, PDF bytes start with %PDF; POST /api/boats/{id}/nested-dxf returns 200 with dxf_url ending .dxf, count=2, size>0, file streams back as ASCII DXF. Empty-boat edge cases: /assembly and /nested-dxf both return 422 for a boat with 0 pieces. Cascade soft delete: DELETE /api/boats/{id} soft-deletes the boat AND its pieces (both GETs 404, piece not in filtered list). Frontend (mobile 390x844 web preview): home shows kicker 'EVA · BOAT MAT' + h1 'PROGETTI'; 'NUOVO PROGETTO' button opens modal with 'Nome imbarcazione' label + boat-name-input + 'CREA PROGETTO' confirm; after creation navigates to /boat/{id}. Boat detail: header shows 'PROGETTO' kicker + boat name, 'TAPPETI / PEZZI (n)' section label, empty state 'Nessun pezzo...' with vector-square icon when 0 pieces (PDF/DXF buttons correctly hidden). 'AGGIUNGI PEZZO' button navigates to /new-project?boat_id={id}&n={n+1}; the new-project form pre-fills 'Nome pezzo' as 'Pezzo N' with a visible 'Nome pezzo' label and dedicated input-name field. Seeded a piece via API and reloaded /boat/{id}: piece card renders with piece_name, dims (500x300 mm), status tag BOZZA; PDF ASSEMBLATO + DXF FOGLIO UNICO buttons now appear above AGGIUNGI PEZZO as expected. No red screens, no new deprecated packages detected in this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/boats/{id}/assembly and /api/boats/{id}/nested-dxf share the _boat_nested() helper which iterates soft-delete-filtered pieces via _boat_pieces() (deleted:{$ne:True}) — correct.
DELETE /api/boats/{id} cascades soft-delete to db.projects.update_many({boat_id:boat_id}) — verified end-to-end.
list_boats returns piece_count and thumb_url by iterating pieces per boat; O(N*M) is fine at MVP scale but consider a $lookup aggregation if boat/piece counts grow.
GET /api/boats/{id} embeds pieces with photo_url/rectified_url — matches frontend BoatT.pieces contract.
422 path in boat_assembly correctly triggers when nested.count==0 (i.e., no piece has any contour_mm) — matches the requested behavior.
Boat.updated_at is bumped on child piece creation via db.boats.update_one — good UX for the 'updated_at' sort in list_boats.
Frontend index.tsx modal uses testID 'boat-name-input' + 'boat-create-confirm' + 'new-boat-btn' + 'boat-card-{id}' + 'delete-{id}' — full testID coverage.
Frontend boat/[id].tsx exposes 'add-piece-btn', 'assembly-pdf-btn', 'nested-dxf-btn', 'piece-card-{id}', 'delete-piece-{id}', 'back-btn', 'empty-pieces' — full testID coverage.
AGGIUNGI PEZZO deep-links n={pieces.length+1}, which pre-fills 'Pezzo N' inside new-project.tsx — nice UX.

All three read EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env; run with `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Boat data model: boats collection stores {name, created_at, updated_at, deleted}; pieces are in the 'projects' collection with boat_id (string form of boat ObjectId) + piece_name. The boat assembly endpoint requires each piece to have a non-empty contour_mm; otherwise it returns 422 with detail 'Nessun pezzo pronto: elabora e definisci i contorni dei pezzi'.
